CONFIG:
# BEGIN OPTIONAL ORIGIN BOT CONFIG
if [ '${{ vars.ORIGIN_BOTS_ENABLED }}' = 'true' ]; then
  bot_exports=/var/snap/docker/common/geupddong-origin-bots/exports
  [ -d "$bot_exports" ]
  [ ! -L "$bot_exports" ]
  printf '%s\n' 'ORIGIN_BOTS_DIRECTORY=/var/lib/geupddong-origin-bots' >> .env
fi
# END OPTIONAL ORIGIN BOT CONFIG
MOUNT:
# BEGIN OPTIONAL ORIGIN BOT MOUNT
if [ '${{ vars.ORIGIN_BOTS_ENABLED }}' = 'true' ]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('docker-compose.yml')
text = path.read_text()
marker = '    # ORIGIN_BOT_READ_ONLY_VOLUME'
assert text.count(marker) == 1
mount = '      - type: bind\n        source: /var/snap/docker/common/geupddong-origin-bots/exports\n        target: /var/lib/geupddong-origin-bots\n        read_only: true\n        bind:\n          create_host_path: false'
if '    volumes:\n' not in text:
    mount = '    volumes:\n' + mount
path.write_text(text.replace(marker, mount))
PY
fi
# END OPTIONAL ORIGIN BOT MOUNT
